audit_summary.space_type: interior corridor or office partition zone

salvageable_components.item_name: textured white wall finish (likely painted gypsum board or plaster)
salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove drywall or plasterboard carefully to avoid dust; separate metal studs from gypsum core for recycling; inspect for hidden wiring or plumbing before cutting.

technical_features.labels_or_markings: standard European Schuko socket marking; no visible brand or certification badge

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Disconnect power supply before removal; inspect for corrosion or damage to internal contacts; clean and test for continuity before reuse.

salvageable_components.item_name: split-type air conditioning indoor unit (Daikin brand)

technical_features.labels_or_markings: Daikin logo visible; model number not legible; likely includes energy efficiency rating sticker (not visible)

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Must be professionally decommissioned by licensed HVAC technician to recover refrigerant; remove mounting brackets and inspect for wall damage; unit may require cleaning and performance testing for reuse.

salvageable_components.item_name: dark gray vertical accent strip (possibly metal or vinyl panel)

technical_features.connection_type: adhered or mechanically fastened to wall

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Carefully remove to preserve surface; check for adhesive residue; may be reusable as decorative panel or partition accent.
Remove with pry bar; inspect for warping or moisture damage; sand and repaint if necessary for reuse.

technical_features.connection_type: glued or mechanically fastened to subfloor

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove using carpet knife; separate backing from fiber; check for contamination; send to specialized carpet recycling facility.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of asbestos in older wall finishes or insulation behind drywall; test for lead-based paint if building predates 1978; inspect electrical wiring for damage or outdated insulation; confirm refrigerant type and pressure in AC unit before dismantling.
